key: This here's our hideout. You cool, so you get in.
en: This here's our hideout. You cool, so you get in.
ja: ここが　オレたちのアジトだ。あんたは　話が分かるから　入れてやるよ

key: There's alleyways like this all over the city, you just gotta look for 'em.
en: There's alleyways like this all over the city, you just gotta look for 'em.
ja: こういう路地は　街じゅうにある。探せばいいだけさ

key: Hey! You sure you got the stuff to score back here?
en: Hey! You sure you got the stuff to score back here?
ja: おい! ここに来るだけの　度胸があるってのか?
いいだろう　あんたは　合格だ

key: My parents'll never find me back here.
en: My parents'll never find me back here.
ja: ここなら　親には　絶対見つからない

key: A Pokémon appears to be leeching power through the metal...
en: A Pokémon appears to be leeching power through the metal...
ja: ポケモンが　金属を通して　電気を吸い取っているようだ……
ポケモンが　おそいかかってきた!
